title: My choice, my reasons
objective: Justifier un choix et donner son opinion avec exemples

steps.title: Warm-up: this or that?
steps.student_instruction: Choose quickly: book or film? Series or game? Say one reason each time.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Questions rapides en chaîne ; noter au tableau les justifications courtes à enrichir.

steps.title: Listening: My favourite film
steps.student_instruction: Listen to five teenagers. For three of them, note the film, one reason and one example.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire écouter l'audio British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours. Grille film / raison / exemple : c'est la structure attendue en production.

steps.title: Language focus: the PRE chain
steps.student_instruction: Build Point - Reason - Example chains with because, that's why, for example, such as.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Montrer qu'un avis sans raison ni exemple ne convainc pas ; faire enrichir deux phrases du warm-up.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : chaînes PRE à compléter ; B : critique courte de 80 mots ; C : comparer deux choix et trancher avec nuance.

steps.title: One-minute presentations
steps.student_instruction: Present your favourite film, book or game in one minute. The group votes for the best-justified choice.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Groupes de 4 ; grille : opinion claire, deux raisons, un exemple précis ; valoriser la variété des connecteurs.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one PRE chain about today's lesson.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Ramasser ; repérer qui donne un exemple précis.

sheets.student_content: Complete the chains: (1) I love this series ___ the characters are funny. ___, Max always makes silly jokes. (2) I don't like horror films ___ they scare me. ___ I never watch them at night.
sheets.facilitator_correction: (1) because ; For example. (2) because ; That's why.

sheets.student_content: Write an 80-word review of a film or book you love: one opinion, two reasons, one precise example, one recommendation.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : In my opinion, Wonder is the best book about school life because it shows how kindness changes everything. For example, Jack becomes Auggie's friend... That's why I recommend it.

sheets.student_content: Compare two films or books you like. Which one would you recommend to the class? Write 120 words with at least two examples and one concession (although, even if).
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : choix tranché, justifications et exemples précis, concession correctement employée.

criteria: L'élève donne au moins deux raisons
L'élève illustre par un exemple précis

common_errors: For example suivi d'une idée générale
